sentences.text: CORAM : THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE H. C. MISHRA  ------
For the Petitioner : Ms. Rashmi Kumari, Advocate.

For the State : A.P.P.
 ------
2/24.2.2016 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Telaiya P.S case No. 182 of 2015 corresponding to G.R No.830 of 2015, for the offence under Sections 272 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code & 16 (B) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
From the FIR, it appears that the children in a school became ill after consuming the eggs supplied in Mid-Day Meal.
The petitioner is the President of the Village Education Committee and it is alleged that the quality of eggs was not checked before supplying to the children.

In the facts and circumstances of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner, Jageshwar Rajak,
on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned S.D.J.M., Koderma, in connection with Telaiya P.S case No. 182 of 2015,
corresponding to G.R No.830 of 2015.

( H. C. Mishra, J.) BS/
